editorialSummary.heading: What Brownsville ISD families should know for 2026-2027
paragraphs: Brownsville ISD's first class day is Monday, August 10, 2026, and the last class day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Before school starts, Meet the Teacher is scheduled for August 5 at high schools, August 6 at elementary schools, and August 7 at middle schools. The first semester has 85 instructional days.

Students are off for Mini Fall Break October 9-13 and Thanksgiving Break November 23-27. November 11 is scheduled as a Veterans Day student holiday, but BISD may use it as a weather make-up day if needed. Winter Break for students runs December 21 through January 4, with classes resuming January 5.

The second semester has 93 instructional days. Schools dismiss early for Charro Days on February 25: middle schools at 11:45 a.m., elementary schools at 12:15 p.m., and high schools at 1:00 p.m. February 26 is scheduled as the Charro Days student holiday and is also a possible weather make-up day. Spring Break is March 15-19, and Easter Break is March 26-29.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for Brownsville ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first class day is Monday, August 10, 2026. The first six-week grading period begins that day.

faqs.question: What is Brownsville ISD's last class day?
faqs.answer: The final student day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. It also closes the sixth six weeks and second semester.

faqs.question: How many instructional days are on the BISD calendar?
faqs.answer: The approved calendar lists 178 instructional days: 85 in the first semester and 93 in the second.

faqs.question: What are the regular Brownsville ISD school hours?
faqs.answer: Middle schools run 7:40 a.m.-2:50 p.m., elementary schools 8:00 a.m.-3:15 p.m., and high schools 8:45 a.m.-4:10 p.m.

faqs.question: When are the Meet the Teacher dates?
faqs.answer: High schools hold Meet the Teacher on August 5, elementary schools on August 6, and middle schools on August 7. Check your campus for the time.

faqs.question: Are students off for Labor Day?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, September 7, 2026, is a district holiday with no classes.

faqs.question: When is Mini Fall Break?
faqs.answer: Mini Fall Break runs Friday, October 9, through Tuesday, October 13, 2026. Students return Wednesday, October 14.

faqs.question: Is there school on November 11, 2026?
faqs.answer: It is scheduled as a Veterans Day student holiday, but it is also a weather make-up date. Families should keep the day flexible until BISD confirms whether classes are needed.

faqs.question: What week is Thanksgiving Break?
faqs.answer: Students are off November 23-27, 2026, and return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: How long is Winter Break for students?
faqs.answer: Student Winter Break lasts 15 calendar days, from December 21, 2026, through January 4, 2027. Classes resume Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: When do Brownsville ISD students return after Winter Break?
faqs.answer: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027, after Winter Break ends January 4.

faqs.question: Why do staff and students have different winter dates?
faqs.answer: The calendar ends staff Winter Break on January 1 and lists January 4 as a teacher preparation day. Students remain home through January 4.

faqs.question: Is there school on Presidents Day in Brownsville ISD?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, February 15, 2027, is a district holiday with no student classes.

faqs.question: Is Brownsville ISD closed for Charro Days?
faqs.answer: Brownsville ISD has early dismissal on Thursday, February 25. Friday, February 26 is scheduled as the Charro Days student holiday, although BISD may use it as a weather make-up day if needed.

faqs.question: When is the Charro Days early dismissal?
faqs.answer: Students at all school levels are released early Thursday, February 25, 2027, for Charro Days.

faqs.question: What time does each school level dismiss on February 25?
faqs.answer: Middle schools dismiss at 11:45 a.m., elementary schools at 12:15 p.m., and high schools at 1:00 p.m.

faqs.question: Will students attend on Charro Days, February 26?
faqs.answer: February 26 is scheduled as the Charro Days holiday, but it is also a weather make-up date. Attendance is possible if BISD needs to recover lost instructional time.

faqs.question: When is Spring Break for Brownsville ISD?
faqs.answer: Spring Break runs March 15-19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: What dates are included in Easter Break?
faqs.answer: Easter Break runs Friday, March 26, through Monday, March 29, creating one continuous four-day break. Classes resume March 30.

faqs.question: When do the six grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The six-week periods end September 18, October 30, December 18, February 19, April 9, and May 26. They contain 29, 27, 29, 33, 27, and 33 instructional days, respectively.

faqs.question: What happens if BISD has a weather closure?
faqs.answer: The district may use November 11 or February 26 as a make-up day. Families should watch official district and campus messages before assuming either date will remain free.

faqs.question: Is the ADSY/Extended Day calendar the same as the regular calendar?
faqs.answer: No. The ADSY/Extended Day calendar adds program-specific dates before, during, and after the regular school year. It should be used only by families whose students participate in those programs.

faqs.question: Which Brownsville ISD campuses use ADSY or Extended Day?
faqs.answer: The district's ADSY/Extended Day PDF does not list participating campuses. Families should confirm participation and attendance requirements with their school.

faqs.question: Where can parents get the official 2026-2027 calendars?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF links on this page or visit Brownsville ISD's 2026-2027 School Year Calendars document page.

editorialSummary.heading: How the Brownsville ISD ADSY/Extended Day calendar works
paragraphs: The ADSY schedule starts with two July blocks, returns for five Saturdays from January through April, and continues on selected weekdays in June. In all, the calendar marks 30 ADSY dates from July 20 through June 23.
Extended Day begins August 17 and is marked on 123 dates through May 13. The dates fall Monday through Thursday, with gaps around holidays, staff dates, early dismissal and other unmarked days.

Regular classes still run August 10-May 26, and participating students follow the district's major holiday breaks. November 11 and February 26 remain possible weather make-up days. The supplemental PDF does not list participating campuses or Extended Day hours, so families should confirm program eligibility and daily times with their school.

November 11 and February 26 remain conditional weather make-up dates for program students as well as the regular calendar.

faqs.question: What is the Brownsville ISD ADSY/Extended Day calendar?
faqs.answer: It is a supplemental schedule for students in participating ADSY or Extended Day programs; it does not replace Brownsville ISD's regular calendar. The PDF marks 30 ADSY dates and 123 Extended Day dates.

faqs.question: Who should follow the ADSY and Extended Day dates?
faqs.answer: Only students assigned to participating ADSY or Extended Day programming should follow the extra dates. The PDF does not name the campuses, so families should confirm eligibility with their school.

faqs.question: Which Brownsville ISD campuses or grade levels participate in ADSY/Extended Day?
faqs.answer: The district's ADSY/Extended Day PDF does not list participating campuses or grade levels. Families should confirm participation with their school.

faqs.question: What does ADSY stand for?
faqs.answer: ADSY stands for Additional Days School Year, a Texas program that supports additional instructional days beyond the regular school calendar. Brownsville ISD's supplemental calendar marks 30 ADSY dates for participating students.

faqs.question: When is the first listed ADSY date?
faqs.answer: The first ADSY date is Monday, July 20, 2026. The opening summer blocks run July 20-23 and July 27-30.

faqs.question: What is the last ADSY attendance date?
faqs.answer: The final ADSY date is Wednesday, June 23, 2027, at the end of the June 21-23 block.

faqs.question: How many ADSY days are marked?
faqs.answer: The calendar marks 30 ADSY dates: eight in July, five Saturdays from January through April, and seventeen weekdays in June.

faqs.question: Which Saturdays are ADSY days?
faqs.answer: The five Saturday ADSY dates are January 30, February 6, February 20, March 6, and April 3.

faqs.question: What are the June ADSY ranges?
faqs.answer: June ADSY instruction is marked for June 1-4, June 7-11, June 14-18, and June 21-23.

faqs.question: How many Extended Day dates are on the calendar?
faqs.answer: The PDF labels 123 Extended Day dates between August 17, 2026, and May 13, 2027.

faqs.question: When does Extended Day programming begin and end?
faqs.answer: The first Extended Day block begins August 17, 2026. The last marked block runs May 10-13, 2027.

faqs.question: Does Extended Day run every weekday?
faqs.answer: No. All marked Extended Day dates fall Monday through Thursday, but Extended Day is not scheduled every Monday through Thursday. Holidays, breaks, staff dates, early release, and other gaps interrupt the schedule.

faqs.question: Are Extended Day start and dismissal times listed?
faqs.answer: No. The PDF identifies the dates but does not print daily Extended Day hours. Families need to get program times from their campus.

faqs.question: When do regular classes begin for ADSY/Extended Day students?
faqs.answer: The regular instructional calendar begins Monday, August 10, 2026. The July ADSY dates take place before that districtwide first class day.

faqs.question: When does the regular school year end on this calendar?
faqs.answer: The regular last class day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. ADSY programming then continues on selected dates through June 23.

faqs.question: Do ADSY/Extended Day students follow the district holiday breaks?
faqs.answer: The supplemental grid retains Labor Day, Mini Fall Break, Thanksgiving Break, student Winter Break, Presidents Day, Spring Break, and Easter Break.

faqs.question: Is February 25 an Extended Day date?
faqs.answer: No. February 25 is marked as the Charro Days early-dismissal date, not an Extended Day session.

faqs.question: Can November 11 or February 26 become attendance days?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are marked as student holidays and weather make-up options, so BISD may require attendance if lost instructional time must be recovered.

faqs.question: Do students attend every purple or green date?
faqs.answer: Those colors identify Extended Day and ADSY dates, but attendance applies only to participating students. Campus instructions determine who is expected to attend.

faqs.question: Where is the official ADSY/Extended Day PDF?
faqs.answer: The official download is linked on this page and is also published in Brownsville ISD's 2026-2027 School Year Calendars document collection.

about.dataSource: This page uses Brownsville ISD's 2026-2027 ADSY/Extended Day Calendar together with the board-approved regular instructional calendar. Every green ADSY date, purple Extended Day date, holiday, early dismissal, and weather make-up marker was checked visually.
about.processing: ADSY dates total 30 and Extended Day dates total 123. Consecutive marked dates are grouped, but weekends and unmarked gaps are never pulled into a range. Staff-only dates are excluded unless they change student attendance.
about.updates: The supplied PDF does not list participating campuses or daily program hours. Those details should be added only from an official district or campus source.
about.disclaimer: This independent reference is not operated by Brownsville ISD. Program participation, transportation, meals, attendance requirements, and daily times must be confirmed with BISD or the student's campus.
